name: Cloud Chamber
desc: A Wilson cloud chamber raked by a sheet of light — ionizing particles condense their paths out of supersaturated vapour: fat alpha stubs fanning off a source pin, thin cosmic muons falling clean through, and low-momentum electrons curling into tight spirals in the magnetic field, every track fattening and diffusing away seconds after it is born.

energy.doc: particle energy — track length, brightness, straightness (less multiple scattering)

scale.doc: chamber magnification — track size and step length

density.doc: flux: how many tracks are alive at once

field.doc: magnetic field — how tightly low-momentum tracks curl and spiral

diffuse.doc: droplet diffusion — how fast a track fattens, softens and fades away

hue.doc: light-sheet hue (196 = cold vapour blue); plate and ink derive from it

x.doc: source pin x — alpha tracks fan from here

y.doc: source pin y, and the centre of the raking light sheet

seed.doc: event seeding — every track incarnation rehashes from it
